input: integer token embedding, pad=1; float32 pixels x/255-.5; no fitted preprocessing
pair_head: shared independent document encoder; concatenate abs(a-b) and a*b; one linear head
selection: maximum validation accuracy; earliest tie; evaluate only selected weights on test
budget: 100 full-data epochs; no tuning on test; report per-task accuracy, params, time, memory
scope: Engineering candidates only. Minimal official S4D is explicitly pedagogical; this is not a S4/S5/MEGA reproduction or a justified top-x cohort.
